welcome.title: A quick check of your health
welcome.body: Answer a few simple questions. In about 2 minutes you will get your health score and a plan to improve.
welcome.privacy: Your answers stay on your phone only. No login needed.
welcome.disclaimer: This is for awareness and education only. It is not a diagnosis. Please see a doctor for medical advice.

common.scanSubtitle: Point your phone camera here to take this health check.
common.shareText: Know Your Health — take this free 2-minute health check:

fields.waistHelp: Measure around your tummy at the navel.
fields.knownHypertension: Has a doctor told you that you have high blood pressure (or are you on BP medicine)?
fields.knownDiabetes: Has a doctor told you that you have diabetes (or are you on sugar medicine)?
fields.bpKnown: Do you know your blood pressure?
fields.activityVigorous: Very active — hard work or regular exercise
fields.activityModerate: Fairly active — some walking or work
fields.dietMixed: A mix of healthy and unhealthy
fields.dietPoor: Often fried, sweet or packaged food
fields.fruitVeg: Do you eat fruits and vegetables every day?
fields.highSalt: Do you eat a lot of salt, pickles or papad?
fields.tobacco: Do you use tobacco (smoking or chewing)?
fields.sleep: How many hours do you sleep at night?
fields.stress: Do you often feel stressed or tense?
fields.labsIntro: If you have recent blood test results, add them. You can skip this.

report.title: Your health report
report.noPriorities: You are doing well — keep up your good habits!
report.tierExcellentSub: Your health looks good. Keep up these habits.
report.tierGoodSub: You're close. Small changes will help a lot.
report.tierFairSub: A few habits need attention now to stay healthy.
report.tierPoorSub: Please act on these and see a doctor soon.

compare.title: Your progress
compare.needMore: Do the check again on another day to see your progress here.
compare.scoreUp: Your score went up by {{points}} points. Well done!
compare.scoreDown: Your score went down by {{points}} points. Let's get back on track.
compare.scoreSame: Your score is the same as before.

history.title: Past reports
history.empty: No reports yet. Finish a health check to see it here.
